headlines.description: Jurrien Timber, Eberechi Eze and Bukayo Saka all scored in seven scintillating second-half minutes to fire Arsenal to a comfortable 3-0 Champions League win against Lille at the Emirates Stadium.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arsenal hit three in seven minutes to beat Lille

headlines.description: Manchester United's winless run extended to a fifth match as Michael Carrick's side made a nightmare start and lost Leny Yoro to a red card in Tuesday's 2-0 Champions League defeat at Atletico Madrid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yoro sent off as Man Utd lose 2-0 to Atlético

headlines.description: Anthony Gordon scored his first Champions League goal for Barcelona as they came from behind to beat Galatasaray 4-1 in Istanbul to maintain a perfect 10-for-10 start to the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barcelona storm back to beat Gala as perfect season rolls on

headlines.description: Viking scored a 90th-minute equaliser to hold Harry Kane and Bayern Munich to a thrilling 3-3 Champions League draw.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kane double not enough as Viking hold 10-Man Bayern

headlines.description: Bradley Barcola responded to growing but scrutiny of his performances to score his first Champions League hat trick in Liverpool's 6-3 win over LASK Linz.
headlines.shortLinkText: Liverpool rout LASK Linz with Barcola's first UCL hat trick

headlines.description: Real Madrid scored three goals in seven minutes, all from corner kicks, to mount a dramatic comeback and claim a 4-3 win at AS Roma in the Champions League on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Real Madrid's late rally stuns Roma in 7-goal thriller

headlines.description: Mason Greenwood endured a nightmare return to English football as Aston Villa ran riot in a 6-0 win against his Fenerbahce side in the Champions League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Villa run riot in 6-0 thrashing of Fenerbahce

headlines.description: Pep Guardiola's return ended in defeat on Wednesday as Manchester City lost 4-2 to Paris Saint-Germain in their first home match since being found guilty of serious financial irregularities.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG hold off Man City's Haaland-inspired fightback
